payload.name: Chargebee (EU Region)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
payload.longDescription:
将 ChatGPT 连接到实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和支付数据。用自然语言询问账单问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、支付失败模式、贷项通知单缺漏、按计费周期划分的客户终身价值（LTV）及试用转化。

这些交叉关联之所以能够实现，是因为 Chargebee 将完整的商业事件链保存在一个相互关联的数据模型中——支付事件、方案变更、发票记录、取消原因——全部彼此连接，并带有时间戳。

payload.name: OakbrookOne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OakbrookOne in ChatGPT helps you explore how turning multiple debts into one monthly payment could work for you - through a simple conversation. 

Share details about the debts you’re managing and see illustrative repayment scenarios. You can understand how combining balances into one structured plan might affect your monthly payment and overall repayment timeline. 

If you choose to proceed, you can continue your application securely on Oakbrook’s website. OakbrookOne will arrange repayment directly with your existing creditors if your application is approved. 

OakbrookOne provides general information and example calculations only. Eligibility, loan terms and creditor repayment are subject to Oakbrook’s standard lending assessment.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT 中的 OakbrookOne 通过简单的对话，帮助你了解将多笔债务合并为一笔月供是否适合自己。

分享你正在管理的债务详情，查看示例还款情景。你可以了解将多笔余额整合到一套有计划的还款方案中，可能如何影响月供和总体还款期限。

如果决定继续，可以在 Oakbrook 网站上安全地完成后续申请。申请获批后，OakbrookOne 将直接与你现有的债权人安排偿还。

OakbrookOne 仅提供一般信息和示例计算。申请资格、贷款条款及向债权人还款均须通过 Oakbrook 的标准贷款评估。

payload.name: Clear Energy Facts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clear Energy Facts gives you an up-to-date list of the best true fixed-rate electricity plans, along with the top free-nights and free-weekends plans on the market. Instead of wading through confusing offers and hidden fees, you get straightforward plan data you can trust. When paired with your Smart Meter Texas (SMT) usage data, it helps match your actual consumption patterns to the plan that will genuinely cost you the least — whether that's a steady fixed rate or a plan built around free nights and weekends.
payload.longDescription: Clear Energy Facts 提供最新的优质真正固定电价套餐列表，以及市场上领先的夜间免费和周末免费套餐。无需费力研究令人困惑的优惠和隐藏费用，你能获得直接、可信的套餐数据。结合 Smart Meter Texas（SMT）的用电数据，它可将实际消费规律与真正总成本最低的套餐匹配，无论是稳定固定电价，还是围绕夜间与周末免费设计的方案。

payload.name: Superfunds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Superfunds is a live, comprehensive map of the Israeli mutual fund market. Ask in plain language — Hebrew or English — to find and filter funds by manager, theme, or strategy; compare fees, performance, and risk; browse curated themes and recently launched funds; view manager profiles with market share; and search market research and central-bank context. Informational only — not investment advice.
payload.longDescription: Superfunds 是以色列共同基金市场的实时全面地图。用日常语言（希伯来语或英语）提问，按管理人、主题或策略查找和筛选基金；比较费用、表现和风险；浏览精选主题与新推出的基金；查看含市场份额的管理人资料；搜索市场研究和央行背景信息。仅供信息参考，不提供投资建议。

payload.name: U.S. Gold Bureau Metal Spots
payload.description: 获取实时金属现货价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get the live spot price of gold, silver, platinum, and palladium along with the price change for the day. Compare all metals current spot price at a glance.
payload.longDescription: 获取黄金、白银、铂金和钯金的实时现货价格，以及当日价格变化。一目了然地比较所有金属的当前现货价格。

payload.name: D&B Risk Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Execute risk workflows powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com.

Dun & Bradstreet empowers teams to execute risk workflows such as KYC/KYB, entity resolution, screening, alert triage, and more using relationship-aware business context from the D&B Commercial Graph™. Verified risk data, anchored in the global standard D-U-N-S® Number business identifier, and policy-driven logic provide the foundation for consistent decisioning across systems of record and scalable risk operations in regulated environments.

You can use D&B Risk Analytics to:

Verify and onboard suppliers:
"Can you verify and cross-check the data from my vendor outreach form for <Company Name> for accuracy?"
Initiate third-party screening:
"Load this <Company Name> and initiate screening"
Assess overall risk:
"What is the overall risk rating for <Company Name>, and what are the key drivers behind it?"
Trace beneficial ownership:
"Who ultimately owns and controls <Company Name>, and are any owners or directors located in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions?"
Generate KYB decision reports:
"Give me a full KYB decision report for <Company Name> — should we approve, refer, or decline?"

Note: Requires D&B Risk Analytics license.
payload.longDescription:
执行由 D&B Commercial Graph™ 支持的风险管理工作流

如有咨询，请联系 OpenAILeads@dnb.com。

Dun & Bradstreet 帮助团队利用 D&B Commercial Graph™ 中考虑企业关系的业务背景信息，执行 KYC/KYB、实体匹配、筛查、警报分流等风险工作流。以全球标准企业标识 D-U-N-S® Number 为基础的已核实风险数据，加上由政策驱动的逻辑，为各记录系统中的一致决策，以及受监管环境中可扩展的风险运营提供基础。

你可以使用 D&B Risk Analytics：

核实并准入供应商：
“能否核实并交叉检查我向 <Company Name> 发出的供应商联系表中的数据是否准确？”
启动第三方筛查：
“加载 <Company Name> 并启动筛查”
评估总体风险：
“<Company Name> 的总体风险评级是什么，主要驱动因素有哪些？”
追踪受益所有权：
“谁最终拥有并控制 <Company Name>，是否有任何所有者或董事位于高风险或受制裁的司法辖区？”
生成 KYB 决策报告：
“提供一份 <Company Name> 的完整 KYB 决策报告——我们应该批准、转交进一步审查，还是拒绝？”

注意：需要 D&B Risk Analytics 许可证。

payload.name: MyTruv: AI Money Autopilot
payload.description: 与自己的财务数据对话
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Your whole financial life, answered in ChatGPT.

Connect your accounts once, then just ask: "Where did my money go this month?", "How much lands on payday?", "What's hurting my credit score?" MyTruv answers from your real data across checking, savings, credit cards, loans, investments, and payroll.

What you can ask about
• Spending: balances, transactions, and a breakdown by category or merchant
• Bills and subscriptions: recurring charges and recurring income
• Income: gross vs. net pay, taxes, benefits, retirement contributions, and pay history
• Net worth: assets and debts over time, with credit limits, APR, and loan terms
• Credit: your score, what's moving it, utilization, and 24 months of payment history

Keep your data tidy
Ask MyTruv to fix a category, rename a merchant, hide a transaction, or set a rule for a merchant going forward. It confirms before changing many transactions at once.

Private and secure
MyTruv can never move your money. 256-bit AES encryption, SOC 2 Type II certified. No ads. Requires MyTruv Pro. Powered by Truv, trusted by 8M+ consumers.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中获取有关你全部财务生活的答案。

只需连接一次账户，然后提问：“我这个月的钱花到哪里了？”“发薪日会到账多少？”“什么因素在拉低我的信用评分？”MyTruv 会依据你在支票账户、储蓄、信用卡、贷款、投资和工资单中的真实数据回答。

你可以询问的内容
• 支出：余额、交易，以及按类别或商户划分的明细
• 账单和订阅：定期扣款和定期收入
• 收入：税前与税后工资、税款、福利、退休金缴款和工资历史
• 净资产：资产和债务随时间的变化，以及信用额度、APR 和贷款期限
• 信用：你的评分、影响评分的因素、额度使用率，以及 24 个月的还款历史

保持数据整洁
让 MyTruv 更正类别、重命名商户、隐藏交易，或为某商户设置今后的规则。在一次修改多笔交易之前，它会先请求确认。

隐私与安全
MyTruv 绝不能转移你的资金。采用 256 位 AES 加密，通过 SOC 2 Type II 认证。无广告。需要 MyTruv Pro。由 Truv 提供支持，获 8M+ 消费者信赖。

payload.name: Finmagine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Indian & US stock screeners, financial ratios, AI-generated company research (quarterly summaries, concall tone/credibility decoding), market breadth, momentum ranking, and multi-agent Investment Committee analysis — the MCP server for Indian and US stock market intelligence.
payload.longDescription: 印度和美国股票筛选器、财务比率、AI 生成的企业研究（季度摘要、电话会议语气与可信度解读）、市场宽度、动量排名及多智能体投资委员会分析——面向印度和美国股票市场情报的 MCP 服务器。

payload.name: Nella Finance AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nella Finance AI is a read-only financial intelligence assistant for businesses and their accountants. Connect supported accounting platforms and ask questions about cash, performance, KPIs, unusual movements, management information and estimated tax indicators where supported, directly from ChatGPT.

Nella provides clear summaries based on the latest available accounting data and identifies when professional accounting judgement may be required. It does not make payments, post transactions or change accounting records. Tax projections and financial insights are estimates and should not be treated as regulated financial, investment or tax advice.
payload.longDescription:
Nella Finance AI 是面向企业及其会计师的只读财务智能助手。连接支持的会计平台，即可直接在 ChatGPT 中询问现金、经营表现、关键绩效指标、异常变动、管理信息，以及在支持的情况下查询估算税务指标。

Nella 根据最新可用的会计数据提供清晰摘要，并指出何时可能需要专业会计判断。它不会付款、过账交易或更改会计记录。税务预测和财务洞察均为估算，不应被视为受监管的财务、投资或税务建议。

payload.name: REIzer Deal Analysis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
REIzer underwrites a real-estate deal the way an investor would. Give it a price and a few numbers and it returns a 0–100 score, the metrics that matter for that strategy, stress scenarios showing what breaks the deal, every assumption it filled in for you, and a shareable report link.

It covers long-term rental, short-term rental, BRRRR, fix-and-flip, multifamily and new construction. It can compare all six against the same property to find its best use, and solve backwards for the highest price you could pay and still hit your return targets.

Results are software estimates, not financial advice.
payload.longDescription:
REIzer 像投资者一样评估房地产交易。提供价格和几个数字，即可获得 0–100 评分、与该策略相关的重要指标、显示哪些变化会使交易不可行的压力情景、它为你补全的每项假设，以及可分享的报告链接。

覆盖长期出租、短期出租、BRRRR、翻修转售、多户住宅和新建项目。它能针对同一物业比较全部六种策略，寻找最佳用途，并反向计算在仍能达到回报目标的前提下，你可以支付的最高价格。

结果是软件估算，不构成财务建议。

payload.name: MT Newswires
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MT Newswires brings real-time global financial news directly into ChatGPT — providing original, unbiased and comprehensive multi-asset class coverage of capital markets and economies in over 180 topics.

Powered by a global newsroom trusted by the largest banks, brokerages, professional trading, wealth management and research applications globally, every story is built for AI — so you get answers grounded in live market intelligence, not stale data.

What you can do:
• Get the latest news on any ticker and analyze price impact
• Monitor energy sector developments across global equities 
• Track macro events and global central bank signals in real time
• Screen for earnings, M&A, and market-moving headlines

Example prompts:
→ "What is the latest news for NVIDIA and has it influenced the stock's price?"
→ "Summarize the major analyst rating change developments from the past hour."
→ "What macro events are driving markets today?"
payload.longDescription:
MT Newswires 将实时全球金融新闻直接带入 ChatGPT，针对资本市场和经济提供原创、客观且全面的多资产类别报道，涵盖超过 180 个主题。

其全球新闻编辑团队受到全球大型银行、券商、专业交易、财富管理及研究应用的信赖。每篇报道均为 AI 使用而构建，让你的答案基于实时市场情报，而非过时数据。

你可以：
• 获取任意股票代码的最新新闻并分析价格影响
• 监控全球股票市场中的能源行业动态
• 实时跟踪宏观事件及全球央行信号
• 筛查财报、并购及影响市场的新闻标题

提问示例：
→ “NVIDIA 的最新新闻是什么，是否影响了股价？”
→ “总结过去一小时主要的分析师评级调整动态。”
→ “今天哪些宏观事件正在推动市场？”

payload.name: Energy Ogre
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Energy Ogre helps Texas residents understand what they may be able to save on electricity. Check availability in your ZIP, enter a few details about your home and recent bill, and receive a personalized savings estimate with projected costs and a 12-month breakdown—all within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Energy Ogre 帮助得克萨斯州居民了解可能节省多少电费。检查邮政编码所在地区是否可用，输入住所和近期账单的一些信息，即可在 ChatGPT 中获得个性化节省额估算、预计费用及 12 个月的明细。

payload.name: Seguro Match
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Seguro Match helps users in Spain compare real home, car, and motorcycle insurance quotes in ChatGPT. The model opens a guided quote wizard; the embedded widget collects the required details (with catalog and address lookups), runs the quotes against authorized insurer systems, and shows comparable offers and coverage details. To skip the form, users can drag and drop their current policy document into the widget — it is processed server-side only (extracted text used solely to pre-fill the quote, never sent to the model). Final checkout happens on seguromatch.com; nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Seguro Match 帮助西班牙用户在 ChatGPT 中比较真实的住宅、汽车和摩托车保险报价。模型打开带引导的报价向导；嵌入式组件收集所需详情（支持目录和地址查询），向经授权的保险公司系统获取报价，并显示可比较的方案和保障详情。要跳过表单，用户可将现有保单文件拖放到组件中——文件仅在服务器端处理（提取的文字仅用于预填报价信息，绝不会发送给模型）。最终结账在 seguromatch.com 完成；ChatGPT 内不会发生任何购买。

payload.name: S&P Global - Adaptive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: S&P Global - Adaptive is designed for open-ended, complex workflows where the data path isn't predefined. Submit a natural language query and the system dynamically routes across S&P Global data sources, from Market Intelligence to Energy data, generating queries and assembling cited results automatically. Built by Kensho, S&P Global’s AI innovation engine, the solution is ideal for deep research, multi-step analysis, and autonomous agent workflows. Can be used alongside S&P Global - Deterministic for teams that need both structured and flexible data access.
payload.longDescription: S&P Global - Adaptive 面向数据路径未预先定义的开放式复杂工作流程。提交自然语言查询后，系统会在 S&P Global 数据源之间动态路由，从 Market Intelligence 到 Energy 数据，自动生成查询并组合带有引用的结果。此方案由 S&P Global 的 AI 创新引擎 Kensho 开发，适合深入研究、多步骤分析及自主智能体工作流程。对于同时需要结构化和灵活数据访问的团队，可与 S&P Global - Deterministic 配合使用。

payload.name: Fahali
payload.description: 面向 AI 智能体的市场情报
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fahali gives AI agents eyes on market risk. 18 detection engines deliver anomaly, capital-flow, regime, dark-pool, whale, contagion, and crash-precursor intelligence across crypto and equities/ETFs. Every signal is resolved against realized price in an append-only ledger. All 22 tools are read-only — no order routing, no path to capital. Engines without enough resolved outcomes report 'calibrating' — never an invented number. Observation, not financial advice.
payload.longDescription: Fahali 让 AI 智能体看见市场风险。18 个检测引擎针对加密货币及股票／ETF，提供异常、资金流、市场状态、暗池、大额持有者、风险传染及崩盘前兆情报。每个信号都会在仅可追加的账本中依据实际价格验证结果。全部 22 个工具均为只读，不进行订单路由，也没有触及资金的途径。缺乏足够已验证结果的引擎会显示“校准中”，绝不编造数值。仅作观察，不提供财务建议。

payload.name: Mansa African Markets
payload.description: 实时非洲股票市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Live African market data across 13 exchanges, including NGX,  NASD, GSE, NSE, JSE, and BRVM. Get stock prices, top movers, indices, market overview, and corporate disclosures powered by NGX Pulse and Mansa Markets.
payload.longDescription: 覆盖 13 家交易所的实时非洲市场数据，包括 NGX、NASD、GSE、NSE、JSE 和 BRVM。获取由 NGX Pulse 和 Mansa Markets 提供的股价、涨跌幅领先个股、指数、市场总览和公司披露信息。

payload.name: Manulife®
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Seamlessly go from quote discovery to purchase. Answer a few questions about your trip to receive a personalized CoverMe® Travel Insurance quote, then continue to CoverMe.com, where your information carries over to help make purchasing coverage quick and easy.  
Before You Get Your Quote
To generate your travel insurance quote, we'll ask for information such as your date of birth, province of residence, travel destination, travel dates, and trip cost. Manulife uses the information received through this plugin to generate your quote, assess eligibility, and support the travel insurance quote and purchase process. Please provide only the information requested, and do not share additional information unless specifically requested as part of the quote process.
This plugin is available through ChatGPT, which is provided by OpenAI and is subject to OpenAI's terms, privacy practices, account settings, and data-handling practices.
This tool is intended only to help you request a travel insurance quote. It cannot be used to submit or manage a claim, request emergency or travel assistance, or send urgent or time-sensitive communications to Manulife. It supports single-trip coverage for one traveller. If you have pre-existing medical conditions, are looking for multi-trip or group coverage, or are not a Canadian citizen or resident, this tool may not be suitable for your needs. Do not use this tool to provide detailed medical information, health histories, treatment information, or other sensitive personal information. If you provide information about other individuals, please make sure you have their permission to do so.  
This experience helps you obtain a travel insurance quote and does not provide professional insurance advice. 
The quote provided is for informational purposes only and is not an insurance contract or guarantee of coverage.
For more information about how your information is collected, used, and protected, please review our Canadian Privacy Policy and Legal Information & Disclosures.
payload.longDescription:
从查找报价到购买，流程顺畅衔接。回答几个有关旅程的问题，即可获得个性化 CoverMe® 旅行保险报价，随后前往 CoverMe.com。你填写的信息会同步过去，让购买保障更快捷方便。
获取报价之前
为生成旅行保险报价，我们会询问出生日期、居住省份、旅行目的地、旅行日期及旅行费用等信息。Manulife 使用通过此插件收到的信息生成报价、评估资格，并支持旅行保险报价及购买流程。请仅提供所要求的信息；除非报价流程明确要求，否则不要分享额外信息。
此插件通过 ChatGPT 提供。ChatGPT 由 OpenAI 提供，受 OpenAI 的条款、隐私惯例、账户设置及数据处理惯例约束。
本工具仅用于帮助你申请旅行保险报价，不能用于提交或管理理赔、请求紧急或旅行援助，或向 Manulife 发送紧急或有时效要求的信息。它支持一名旅客的单次旅行保障。如果你有既往疾病、需要多次旅行或团体保障，或不是加拿大公民或居民，此工具可能不适合你的需求。请勿使用此工具提供详细医疗信息、健康史、治疗信息或其他敏感个人信息。如提供他人的信息，请确保已获得其许可。
此体验帮助你获取旅行保险报价，不提供专业保险建议。

payload.name: TickerLayer
payload.description: 股票、外汇与加密货币数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TickerLayer brings real-time and historical global market data directly into ChatGPT. Access stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, commodities and government bond yields across markets worldwide.

Stocks & ETFs: Get live market snapshots, bid/ask quotes, latest trades, previous closes and historical OHLCV data for US and international equities and ETFs.

Forex & crypto: Check real-time currency pairs and cryptocurrency prices, compare markets and retrieve historical price data across custom date ranges.

Indices & commodities: Follow major global stock indices, gold, oil and other supported commodities with current market data and historical aggregates.

Government bonds: Check the latest US and major European government bond yields across supported maturities, including US Treasury yields.

Market hours: See whether markets are open, closed, in pre-market or post-market, and check trading sessions, holidays and early closures across supported regions.

Ask natural-language questions such as “How is Nvidia trading today?”, “Compare Bitcoin and gold over the last year”, “What is USD/TRY now?” or “What is the latest US 10-year Treasury yield?” and get answers backed by TickerLayer market data.

Built for investors, analysts, traders, developers and anyone who needs real-time or historical multi-asset financial market data inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
TickerLayer 将全球市场的实时和历史数据直接带入 ChatGPT。获取世界各地市场的股票、外汇、加密货币、指数、ETF、大宗商品和政府债券收益率。

股票与 ETF：获取美国和国际股票及 ETF 的实时市场快照、买卖报价、最新成交、前收盘价和历史 OHLCV 数据。

外汇与加密货币：查看实时货币对和加密货币价格、比较市场，并获取自定义日期范围内的历史价格数据。

指数与大宗商品：通过当前市场数据和历史汇总数据，跟踪全球主要股票指数、黄金、石油及其他支持的大宗商品。

政府债券：查看美国和欧洲主要国家政府债券在支持期限内的最新收益率，包括美国国债收益率。

市场交易时间：查看市场处于开市、休市、盘前还是盘后状态，并查询支持地区的交易时段、节假日和提前收市安排。

用自然语言提问，例如“今天 Nvidia 的交易情况如何？”、“比较 Bitcoin 与黄金在过去一年的表现”、“USD/TRY 现在是多少？”或“最新美国 10 年期国债收益率是多少？”，即可获得由 TickerLayer 市场数据支持的答案。

专为投资者、分析师、交易员、开发者，以及任何需要在 ChatGPT 中获取多资产金融市场实时或历史数据的人打造。

payload.name: Shinhan Securities Assistant

payload.name: TradingNX Risk Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TradingNX Risk Manager helps traders check planned trades before entry. payload.name: Pet Insurance Comparison
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fletch Pet Insurance Marketplace helps pet owners find and compare pet insurance plans from leading top providers — all in one conversation.
Tell the app about your pet and get live quotes from multiple providers side by side. Compare monthly premiums, deductibles, annual limits, and coverage details. When you're ready, click through directly to your chosen carrier's website to complete enrolment.

支持的宠物：狗和猫。仅向美国居民提供。

payload.name: Stable.com

payload.name: Datarails FinanceOS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Datarails FinanceOS brings structure and intelligence to your financial data. It provides a managed, organized database that keeps your numbers clean and reliable. payload.name: SkyWatch.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

 This app provides renters aviation insurance quotes based on the information shared during the conversation. Final pricing, eligibility, and policy issuance occur through SkyWatch’s official web platform and remain subject to underwriting review and applicable state requirements.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: MutuiOnline.it

payload.name: PocketSmith Complete Access
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.

This connector lets ChatGPT have full secure access to your PocketSmith data, so that you can work with your finances in plain language.

Understand your money: search, filter and categorize your transactions in plain language. Investigate patterns across all your accounts, check balances, and review your categories, labels and saved searches.

Go beyond "what did I spend?": uncover unusual merchant and timing patterns, see what your spending reveals about your priorities and turn years of financial data into answers, stories and decisions that feel relevant to your life.

Get answers to questions like: "why does my cash flow dip next month?", "what changed our net worth most this year?" and "what does our spending suggest we valued, and which choices bought us the most joy, ease or security?"

Keep your budget in check: review budget performance, analyze spending trends across periods, find recurring expenses, plus access monthly reviews and financial health snapshots.

Plan ahead: use PocketSmith's forecasting engine to predict future cashflow and net worth, and manage the budget events that map out your future.

Keep things tidy: categorize your transactions, create new category rules, manage files and sync bank feeds.

Seamlessly jump to PocketSmith: describe the report you need to see in PocketSmith, and you'll get a deep link to that exact report in PocketSmith.

ChatGPT connects to PocketSmith via OAuth - when you connect, you sign in with PocketSmith and can revoke access any time. A read-only version of this connector is also available, if you don't want Claude to ever modify your data.
payload.longDescription:

此连接器让 ChatGPT 能够安全、完整地访问你的 PocketSmith 数据，帮助你用日常语言处理财务。

了解资金状况：用日常语言搜索、筛选和分类交易。研究各账户的规律、查看余额，并检查类别、标签和已保存的搜索。

不止回答“我花了多少钱”：发现异常的商家和时间规律，了解支出透露出的个人优先事项，将多年的财务数据转化为贴近生活的答案、故事与决策。

顺畅跳转到 PocketSmith：描述你想在 PocketSmith 中查看的报告，即可获得直达该报告的深层链接。

ChatGPT 通过 OAuth 连接 PocketSmith；连接时使用 PocketSmith 登录，你可随时撤销访问权限。如果不希望 Claude 修改你的数据，还可使用此连接器的只读版本。

payload.name: Vestd

payload.name: D&B Finance Analytics

payload.name: Vantixs

The ChatGPT app connects to the Vantixs MCP server so users can inspect node schemas, validate pipeline JSON, browse templates, review saved strategies, run backtests, and monitor portfolios from natural-language conversations. Trading-related actions are protected by OAuth and explicit confirmation flows.

payload.name: Revolut X
payload.description: 管理你的加密货币投资组合

It can also prepare a prefilled order-form link. It does not place, replace, or cancel orders.

payload.name: FinRank Shiver

payload.longDescription: FinRank Shiver 将银行和信用合作社的监管数据及市场信号带入 ChatGPT。用户可以用日常英语询问美国金融机构的同业基准、财务指标、当前利率、利率和促销变化、存款市场份额、网点网络和并购活动。

payload.name: Addy AI
payload.description: 数日内完成住房抵押贷款
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This app is the best way to track your loan pipeline, track your document processing checklist, see loan details, follow up for documents and much more.
payload.longDescription: 此应用是跟踪贷款业务流程、查看文件处理清单、查询贷款详情、跟进所需文件等工作的最佳方式。

payload.name: Fintoc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fintoc helps authorized organization users discover API operations, inspect their parameters, retrieve financial resources and data, and execute approved write operations through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Fintoc 帮助已获授权的组织用户通过 ChatGPT 发现 API 操作、查看其参数、获取财务资源和数据，并执行已获批准的写入操作。

payload.name: BizCover AU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compare business insurance quotes from leading Australian insurers - all in one place. With cover available for thousands of occupations, BizCover makes it easy to find the right protection for your business in minutes.
 
Join over 300,000 Australian businesses who trust BizCover to help protect what they’ve built.
 
Get indicative quotes through our app, then purchase online with flexible payment options and instant cover - so you can get insured and get back to business, fast.
payload.longDescription:
在同一处比较澳大利亚领先保险公司的商业保险报价。BizCover 为数千种职业提供保障选项，让你在几分钟内轻松找到适合企业的保护。

加入超过 300,000 家信赖 BizCover 的澳大利亚企业，一起保护自己建立的事业。

通过应用获取参考报价，再在线购买，享受灵活付款方式和即时生效的保障，让你快速完成投保并回归业务。

payload.name: Tally Markets
payload.description: 执行你自己的退出规则
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Every trading connector makes your AI more capable. Tally makes it accountable. Your AI is the analyst; Tally is the risk officer. Tally gives ChatGPT a trading journal it can operate but never rewrite: every trade starts as a pre-registered thesis with exit rules written before entry, a 24-hour cooling-off separates conviction from capital, and rule-breaking exits require a written justification that stays on the record forever. Ask for a checkup and ChatGPT briefs you on every active thesis, logs fresh evidence against your exit criteria, and flags anything that has objectively triggered. Every closed trade mints a public receipt — entry, exit, result, and your reasoning, word for word. Tally never executes trades.
payload.longDescription: 每个交易连接器都会让 AI 更有能力。Tally 让它承担责任。你的 AI 是分析师，Tally 是风险官。Tally 为 ChatGPT 提供可操作但绝不能改写的交易日志：每笔交易都以事先登记的交易论点开始，退出规则在入场前写好；24 小时冷静期将确信程度与资金投入分开；违反规则的退出需要书面说明，并永久保留在记录中。要求检查时，ChatGPT 会简报每个仍有效的交易论点，根据退出标准记录新证据，并标记客观上已触发条件的事项。每笔已平仓交易都会生成公开凭证——入场、出场、结果及你的推理，逐字保留。Tally 绝不执行交易。

payload.name: Vector Smart Chain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vector Smart Chain helps users inspect current VSC network status, check public wallet balances, review transactions and blocks, and access practical guides for wallets, bridging, VSCDEX, gas, validators, and development.
payload.longDescription: Vector Smart Chain 帮助用户检查当前 VSC 网络状态、查看公开钱包余额、审核交易和区块，并访问有关钱包、跨链桥、VSCDEX、gas、验证者和开发的实用指南。

payload.name: Dakota Platform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access your Dakota Platform data through conversation. Ask questions about your customers, accounts, and transactions without navigating dashboards or writing API calls.

  What you can do:
  - Look up customers and filter by KYB status, type, or name
  - View onramp, offramp, and swap account details
  - Browse transaction history with fees, exchange rates, and blockchain data

  Example queries:
  - "Show me all customers pending KYB review"
  - "What are the recent transactions for this customer?"
  - "List all onramp accounts using USDC on Base"

  Read-only access—your data stays safe. Authenticates securely with your Dakota Platform credentials.
payload.longDescription:
通过对话访问 Dakota Platform 数据。就客户、账户和交易提问，无需操作面板或编写 API 调用。

功能：
- 查找客户，并按 KYB 状态、类型或名称筛选
- 查看法币入金、法币出金和兑换账户详情
- 浏览含费用、汇率和区块链数据的交易历史

查询示例：
- “显示所有待 KYB 审核的客户”
- “此客户最近有哪些交易？”
- “列出所有在 Base 上使用 USDC 的入金账户”

只读访问，保障数据安全。使用 Dakota Platform 凭据进行安全身份验证。

payload.name: Billabex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Billabex is an AI-powered accounts receivable and invoice collection platform that helps finance teams manage customer payment follow-up directly from ChatGPT. 

Review customer accounts, contacts, invoices, credit notes, credit allocations, outstanding balances, overdue receivables, incoming emails, outgoing emails, payment communications, and account tasks in one place. 

Identify unpaid invoices and silent customers, inspect complete account and communication histories, monitor collection priorities, update customer and billing records, manage contacts, pause or resume automated payment reminders, respond to tasks raised by the AI agent, prepare scheduled communications, and send personalized payment reminder emails. 

Billabex centralizes receivables management, customer communication, invoice follow-up, credit control, and debt collection workflows so businesses can reduce late payments, improve cash flow visibility, save time on repetitive collection work, and maintain professional customer relationships.
payload.longDescription:
Billabex 是一个由 AI 驱动的应收账款和发票催收平台，帮助财务团队直接通过 ChatGPT 管理客户付款跟进。

在一处查看客户账户、联系人、发票、贷项通知单、贷项分配、未结余额、逾期应收款、收发邮件、付款沟通及账户任务。

识别未付款发票和无回应的客户，查看完整的账户及沟通历史，监控催收优先级，更新客户及账单记录，管理联系人，暂停或恢复自动付款提醒，回应 AI 智能体提出的任务，准备定时沟通内容，并发送个性化付款提醒邮件。

Billabex 集中管理应收款、客户沟通、发票跟进、信用控制及债款催收流程，帮助企业减少延迟付款、提高现金流可见度、节省重复催收工作耗时，并维护专业的客户关系。

payload.name: CapitalDart
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CapitalDart matches your capital raise to institutional investors and delivers verified contacts with drafted outreach.

Describe your raise in plain language or upload your deck. CapitalDart structures the targeting criteria, ranks matching firms from a directory of more than 70,000 institutional investors, and explains the fit rationale for each. Select the firms you want and CapitalDart delivers verified contacts, including name, title, email, and LinkedIn, with a personalized introduction drafted in your voice. Outreach is drafted only. You review and send from your own accounts.

You can also request an Investor Readiness Report, an analysis of your deck covering readiness score, likely investor objections, and recommended changes, and track every contact through your pipeline from first outreach to closed.

Searches, rankings, and raise analysis are free. Verified contacts and reports use credits from your CapitalDart account, managed at capitaldart.com. Built for CEOs, CFOs, fund managers, and real estate sponsors raising institutional capital.
payload.longDescription:
CapitalDart 将你的融资需求匹配到机构投资者，并提供经过核实的联系人及联系文案草稿。

用日常语言描述融资需求，或上传你的路演演示文稿。CapitalDart 会整理目标筛选条件，从包含超过 70,000 家机构投资者的目录中对匹配机构排序，并解释每家机构的匹配理由。选定所需机构后，CapitalDart 会提供经过核实的联系人，包括姓名、职务、电子邮箱和 LinkedIn，并以你的语气起草个性化介绍。联系内容仅生成草稿，由你审阅并从自己的账户发送。

你还可以申请 Investor Readiness Report，分析路演演示文稿，提供准备度评分、投资者可能提出的异议和修改建议；也可以在流程中跟踪每位联系人，从首次联系直至完成融资。

搜索、排序和融资分析免费。经过核实的联系人和报告会消耗 CapitalDart 账户中的积分，账户可在 capitaldart.com 管理。专为向机构募集资金的 CEO、CFO、基金经理和房地产项目发起人打造。

payload.name: Calculadora de Combustível
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find out instantly whether it's worth filling up with ethanol (alcohol) or gasoline. You enter the price per liter of each fuel at your gas station and the calculator applies the 70% rule: if the ethanol price divided by the gasoline price is below 0.70, ethanol is worth it; otherwise, gasoline is the better choice. You can also enter each fuel's efficiency (km/l) for an even more precise cost-per-kilometer calculation. No sign-up and no personal data collected.
payload.longDescription: 即时了解加乙醇（酒精燃料）还是汽油更划算。输入加油站两种燃料的每升价格，计算器会应用 70% 规则：如果乙醇价格除以汽油价格低于 0.70，则乙醇更划算；否则，汽油是更好的选择。你也可以输入每种燃料的燃油效率（km/l），更精确地计算每公里成本。无需注册，不收集个人数据。

payload.name: RateZip Deposit/Mortgage Rates
payload.description: 美国当前 APY 与贷款利率
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RateZip Deposit and Mortgage Rates gives your assistant current, timestamped, source-attributed US consumer rate information from sources covered by RateZip: high-yield savings and money-market APYs, CD APYs by term, fixed-mortgage rates and APRs, and home-equity/HELOC APRs. Each figure includes when it was observed, its source, and a freshness status; data outside its serving window is withheld rather than presented as current. For deposit comparisons, enter a balance and RateZip will apply each account’s published balance tier. For mortgage context, enter a loan amount to compare it with applicable conforming and jumbo limits. Rates and APYs can change, and published information is not an offer, rate lock, approval, earnings guarantee, personalized lender quote, or financial advice. RateZip does not open accounts, submit applications, underwrite credit, or conduct transactions. Operated by Peklava LLC d/b/a RateZip, NMLS ID 1592292. Equal Housing Opportunity.
payload.longDescription: RateZip Deposit and Mortgage Rates 向助手提供 RateZip 覆盖来源中的美国消费者当前利率信息，带有时间戳和来源标注：高收益储蓄与货币市场账户的 APY、按期限划分的 CD APY、固定房贷利率和 APR，以及房屋净值贷款/HELOC 的 APR。每项数值都包含观测时间、来源和时效状态；超出有效服务时间窗口的数据不会展示为当前数据。比较存款时，输入余额，RateZip 会应用各账户公布的余额档位。查看房贷背景时，输入贷款金额，与适用的合规贷款和大额贷款限额比较。利率和 APY 可能变化，公布的信息不构成要约、利率锁定、批准、收益保证、个性化贷款机构报价或财务建议。RateZip 不开立账户、不提交申请、不审核信贷，也不开展交易。由以 RateZip 名义经营的 Peklava LLC 运营，NMLS ID 1592292。提供平等住房机会。

payload.name: GREI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Invest smart in real estate abroad with GREI. Search global property investment opportunities using everyday language, starting with GREI listings in Greece and Cyprus.

Describe what you are looking for, such as renovated apartments in Athens under €150k or properties in Cyprus near the beach, and GREI will show focused listing cards with prices, locations, key details, investment signals, and links to continue exploring on grei.club.

GREI combines global property search and insights to help investors compare opportunities by budget, location, property type, size, rooms, floor, renovation status, and nearby signals such as metro, beach, universities, healthcare, and cultural venues.
payload.longDescription:
使用 GREI，更明智地投资海外房地产。以日常语言搜索全球房产投资机会，从 GREI 在希腊和塞浦路斯的房源开始。

描述你正在寻找的房产，例如雅典低于 €150k 的已翻新公寓，或塞浦路斯靠近海滩的房产，GREI 会显示有针对性的房源卡片，包含价格、位置、关键详情、投资信号以及继续在 grei.club 探索的链接。

GREI 将全球房产搜索和洞察结合，帮助投资者按预算、位置、房产类型、面积、房间数、楼层、翻新状况，以及附近的地铁、海滩、大学、医疗机构和文化场所等因素比较机会。

payload.name: ualet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ualet connects ChatGPT to your personal financial data, synced automatically from Chilean bank accounts and cards. Ask about monthly spending, budgets, trends, and recurring merchants. List uncategorized transactions and suggest categories for you to review and confirm in the ualet app.
payload.longDescription: ualet 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人财务数据，这些数据自动从智利银行账户和银行卡同步。询问每月支出、预算、趋势和经常交易的商户。列出未分类交易并建议分类，由你在 ualet 应用中审阅和确认。

payload.name: ALPHAPORT.AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring ALPHAPORT.AI financial research and AI workflows into ChatGPT. Explore public-company financials, valuation metrics, operating KPIs, reported segments, ETF holdings, earnings, themes, and company screens. Connect your account to run the AlphaPort pipelines you choose and return to the results when they are ready.
payload.longDescription: 将 ALPHAPORT.AI 金融研究和 AI 工作流程带入 ChatGPT。探索上市公司财务、估值指标、经营 KPI、披露的业务分部、ETF 持仓、财报、主题及公司筛选。连接账户，运行你选择的 AlphaPort 工作流程，并在结果准备好后返回查看。

payload.name: Pazy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Pazy app helps users understand what a funeral plan is and find the plan that best fits their needs.

Through a guided conversation, it analyzes factors such as age, city of residence, and funeral service preferences (cremation or burial, wake or ceremony) to provide personalized recommendations. It also offers clear information about how funeral planning works in Spain, the typical costs of a funeral, and the available options for arranging it in advance.
payload.longDescription:
Pazy 应用帮助用户了解什么是殡葬计划，并寻找最适合其需求的方案。

通过引导式对话，应用分析年龄、居住城市和殡葬服务偏好（火葬或土葬、守灵或仪式）等因素，提供个性化推荐。它还清晰介绍西班牙殡葬规划的运作方式、葬礼的典型费用，以及提前安排的可选方案。

payload.name: Multiples.vc
payload.description: 上市公司可比估值、并购与风投数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Public comps, M&A and VC data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access public comps, verified M&A multiples and VC data straight from ChatGPT.

Built for investment banking, PE and VC ecosystem, Multiples MCP delivers investment-grade valuation intelligence inside your favorite AI tool.

Try queries like "cybersecurity strategic M&A buyers" "median SaaS public NTM multiples," or "biggest VC rounds in Europe this year" and get structured, sourced answers back instantly.
payload.longDescription:
直接通过 ChatGPT 获取上市公司可比估值、经核验的并购估值倍数和风险投资数据。

Multiples MCP 面向投资银行、私募股权（PE）和风险投资（VC）生态系统，在你常用的 AI 工具中提供投资级估值情报。

试着查询“网络安全领域的战略并购买家”“上市 SaaS 公司未来十二个月（NTM）估值倍数中位数”或“今年欧洲最大的风险融资轮次”，即可即时获得结构化、有来源的答案。

payload.name: Hyperline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Hyperline to manage quotes, invoices, subscriptions, customers, products, pricing, taxes, wallets, and revenue data. Use it to answer billing questions, inspect customer context, monitor revenue, and perform safe billing workflows from your Hyperline account.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Hyperline，管理报价、发票、订阅、客户、产品、定价、税费、钱包和收入数据。用它回答账单问题、查看客户背景、监控收入，并从 Hyperline 账户执行安全的账单工作流程。

payload.name: WalleK
payload.description: 跟踪资金、账单及对账单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WalleK is your AI-powered personal finance manager — manage your entire financial life right from chat. Record expenses and income in natural language; track recurring payments and subscriptions with auto-pay; manage loans and installment plans with a full payment schedule; import and reconcile card and bank statements with smart merchant matching; set budgets and get alerts; record your salary; and see your net worth across all accounts at a glance. Keep records in any currency — fiat or crypto — with live market and exchange rates, and gauge the real purchasing power of any amount using built-in inflation data (TR/US/EU/UK). Ask "How much did I spend on dining last month?", "Show my upcoming bills", or "Import this statement" — WalleK keeps everything organized in 4 languages. Your financial data stays on your device and is encrypted server-side; you approve every change WalleK proposes before it's saved.
payload.longDescription: WalleK 是你的AI个人财务管理工具——直接通过聊天管理全部财务生活。用自然语言记录支出和收入；借助自动付款跟踪定期付款及订阅；通过完整付款计划管理贷款和分期方案；利用智能商家匹配导入并核对银行卡及银行对账单；设置预算并接收提醒；记录工资；一目了然地查看全部账户的净资产。以任意货币记录账目——法定货币或加密货币均可——并使用实时市场价格及汇率，结合内置通胀数据（TR/US/EU/UK）衡量任何金额的实际购买力。问“我上个月在餐饮上花了多少钱？”“显示即将到期的账单”或“导入这份对账单”——WalleK 支持4种语言，帮助你有序管理一切。财务数据保留在你的设备上，并在服务器端加密；WalleK 提出的每项变更都须经你批准后才能保存。

payload.name: Amok
payload.description: 柬埔寨银行与科技法规
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Amok gives ChatGPT direct access to Cambodia's banking, fintech, and technology regulation — as verbatim evidence from official sources, never paraphrased.

Ask about bank licensing and prudential rules, technology risk management, liquidity risk, payment systems and Bakong, AML/CFT, or fintech policy. Amok searches a corpus built from Cambodia's official sources — the National Bank of Cambodia's laws, prakas, and guidelines, and the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia — and returns the exact provisions: precise Article citations, current validity, and an official source link on every result so you can verify the original wording yourself. When something is missing from the corpus, Amok says so instead of guessing.

The corpus is in English. Ask in any language — ChatGPT translates and answers grounded in the official text. Results support research and compliance work; they are not a substitute for legal counsel. Free, no account needed.
payload.longDescription:
Amok 让 ChatGPT 直接访问柬埔寨的银行、金融科技和技术监管规定，提供来自官方来源的逐字证据，绝不改写。

可询问银行许可和审慎监管规则、技术风险管理、流动性风险、支付系统及 Bakong、AML/CFT 或金融科技政策。Amok 搜索由柬埔寨官方来源构建的语料库，包括柬埔寨国家银行的法律、prakas 和指引，以及柬埔寨证券交易监管机构的资料，并返回准确条款：每项结果均包含精确条文引用、当前效力和官方来源链接，方便你自行核对原文。如果语料库缺少相关内容，Amok 会明确说明，而不会猜测。

语料库为英文。你可以用任何语言提问，ChatGPT 会翻译并依据官方文本回答。结果支持研究与合规工作，不能代替法律顾问。免费，无需账户。

payload.name: PGicover
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PGicover helps Canadian business owners understand personal guarantee insurance, get an indicative monthly cost estimate for insuring a personal guarantee on commercial debt, and check basic eligibility. Underwritten by Markel, rated A plus by AM Best. Applications are completed at app.pgicover.com.
payload.longDescription: PGicover 帮助加拿大企业主了解个人担保保险，获取为商业债务个人担保投保的参考月度费用估算，并检查基本资格。由 Markel 承保，AM Best 评级为 A plus。申请在 app.pgicover.com 完成。

payload.name: Neptune Flood
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Flooding is one of the most common and costly natural risks in the United States, yet getting a flood insurance quote has often been confusing and time consuming.

This app connects ChatGPT directly to Neptune Flood’s quoting system, allowing you to quickly retrieve real time flood insurance quote information for a specific property. Receive flood insurance pricing information within the ChatGPT conversation in seconds.

The goal is simple: make accessing flood insurance quotes faster, clearer, and easier.
This app provides quote information only. It does not offer advice, recommend coverage amounts, or make coverage decisions.

Important Information

ChatGPT is not an insurance agent, broker, or representative of Neptune Flood. The information presented is based on the details provided at the time of the quote request. This quote does not constitute a binder of coverage, an offer to insure, or a guarantee of coverage. Coverage is subject to underwriting review, eligibility requirements, policy terms, conditions, exclusions, and applicable state regulations.

If you have questions about coverage, limits, deductibles, or whether this policy is appropriate for your needs, please consult a Neptune agent or other insurance professional.

Quotes are valid for sixty (60) days from the date generated, unless otherwise indicated. Pricing, eligibility, and terms are subject to change.

Neptune Flood is not responsible for any reliance placed on information interpreted, summarized, or communicated by third party AI systems.
payload.longDescription:
洪灾是美国最常见、损失最昂贵的自然风险之一，但获取洪水保险报价往往令人困惑且耗时。

此应用将 ChatGPT 直接连接至 Neptune Flood 的报价系统，让你快速获取特定房产的实时洪水保险报价信息。在 ChatGPT 对话中，几秒即可收到洪水保险价格信息。

目标很简单：让洪水保险报价的获取更快、更清晰、更方便。
此应用仅提供报价信息，不提供建议、不推荐保障额度，也不作承保决定。

重要信息

ChatGPT 不是 Neptune Flood 的保险代理人、经纪人或代表。所展示的信息基于申请报价时提供的资料。此报价不构成临时承保凭证、承保要约或保障承诺。保障须符合核保审核、资格要求、保单条款、条件、除外责任，以及适用的州法规。

如对保障范围、限额、免赔额，或该保单是否适合你的需求有疑问，请咨询 Neptune 代理人或其他保险专业人士。

除非另有说明，报价自生成之日起六十（60）天内有效。价格、资格与条款可能变化。

对于因依赖第三方 AI 系统解读、总结或传达的信息而产生的后果，Neptune Flood 不承担责任。

payload.name: Savvly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Savvly MCP helps financial advisors, planning tools, and AI agents compare retirement alternatives, check eligibility, and model lump-sum, monthly-contribution, and full-retirement scenarios. These tools support the Savvly Longevity Benefit, an SEC-registered fund designed to combine market exposure with later-life longevity payouts.
payload.longDescription: Savvly MCP 帮助财务顾问、规划工具和 AI 智能体比较退休方案、检查资格，并模拟一次性投入、每月缴款和完整退休情景。这些工具支持 Savvly Longevity Benefit，这是一只在 SEC 注册的基金，旨在将市场敞口与晚年长寿给付相结合。

payload.name: Pine Labs Payment Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pine Labs Payment Assistant is a secure, read-only connector that helps authorized merchants access and understand their payment data using natural language. It provides clear insights into orders, payments, payment links, settlements, transactions, plans, and subscriptions without creating, modifying, or executing payments.
payload.longDescription: Pine Labs Payment Assistant 是安全的只读连接器，帮助获授权商户通过自然语言访问并理解付款数据。它提供有关订单、付款、付款链接、结算、交易、套餐和订阅的清晰见解，不创建、修改或执行付款。

payload.name: Assurance Emprunteur Lemoine
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimez en quelques secondes le tarif de votre assurance de prêt immobilier et l'économie possible grâce à la loi Lemoine. Répondez à quelques questions et l'app calcule des offres réelles à garanties équivalentes ; un conseiller peut ensuite vous rappeler gratuitement. Service proposé par JeRenegocie, courtier en assurance inscrit à l'ORIAS. Estimations indicatives, sans engagement.
payload.longDescription: 几秒内估算房贷保险价格，以及通过 Lemoine 法可能节省的金额。回答几个问题，应用便会计算保障相同的实际方案；之后顾问可免费致电联系你。服务由已在 ORIAS 登记的保险经纪商 JeRenegocie 提供。估算仅供参考，不具有约束力。

payload.name: Trucordia Go
payload.description: 住宅与汽车保险保费估算
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The ChatGPT Trucordia Go tool helps users explore estimated auto and home insurance premiums in the United States (U.S.) through ChatGPT. End users answer a series of questions and receive a preliminary estimate of U.S. auto and home insurance premiums. When they're ready to get personalized quotes, they receive a URL containing encoded parameters for the Trucordia Go AI assistant, which resumes the process from where they left off.
What Users Can Do:

Get rough monthly premium estimates for U.S. auto and home insurance.
Switch between auto and home quotes in the same conversation — their information carries over.
Continue with Trucordia's own AI assistant for personalized quotes, or get connected with a licensed advisor at Trucordia.
See bundling options for U.S. home and auto insurance.
Collects only limited estimate factors such as ZIP code, driver count, primary driver age, young-driver status, vehicle count, home year built, and square footage. 

What This App Does Not Do:

Does not collect name, street address, date of birth, SSN, email address, payment details, bank details, or health information inside ChatGPT.
Does not collect personal health information.
Does not generate binding quotes or exact pricing.
Does not bind coverage or issue policies.
Does not collect payment card, credit card, or any financial information.
Does not take payments.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT Trucordia Go 工具帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 了解美国（U.S.）汽车和住宅保险的预估保费。最终用户回答一系列问题后，可获取美国汽车和住宅保险保费的初步估算。准备获取个性化报价时，用户会收到包含编码参数的 URL，供 Trucordia Go AI 助手从上次停止的位置继续流程。
用户可以做什么：

获取美国汽车和住宅保险每月保费的粗略估算。
在同一段对话中切换汽车和住宅报价，已提供的信息会沿用。
通过 Trucordia 自有 AI 助手继续获取个性化报价，或联系 Trucordia 的持牌顾问。
查看美国住宅和汽车保险的捆绑选项。
仅收集有限的估算因素，例如邮政编码、驾驶员人数、主要驾驶员年龄、是否有年轻驾驶员、车辆数量、住宅建造年份和平方英尺面积。

本应用不会做什么：

不会在 ChatGPT 内收集姓名、街道地址、出生日期、SSN、电子邮件地址、支付详情、银行详情或健康信息。
不收集个人健康信息。
不生成具有约束力的报价或精确价格。
不承保或签发保单。
不收集支付卡、信用卡或任何财务信息。
不收取付款。

payload.name: HelpDol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Control your business by chatting with ChatGPT.

HelpDol is an AI-powered financial management app for sales professionals, service providers, self-employed workers, freelancers, contractors, and small business owners. Connect your bank account once in the HelpDol app and your income and expenses are imported automatically — no manual typing, no duplicates.

Then just ask. Check your profit, balance, cash flow, accounts payable and receivable, and how much you have paid each helper. Sort out the transfers that still need review, schedule upcoming payments with reminders, generate receipts for helpers and clients, pull your yearly report for the accountant, and charge customers by card or payment link — all from the chat.
payload.longDescription:
通过与 ChatGPT 对话管理你的业务。

HelpDol 是由 AI 驱动的财务管理应用，面向销售人员、服务提供商、自雇人士、自由职业者、承包商及小企业主。在 HelpDol 应用中连接一次银行账户，收入和支出便会自动导入，无需手动输入，也不会重复导入。

之后只需提问。查看利润、余额、现金流、应付及应收账款，以及向每位帮工支付了多少费用。处理仍需审核的转账、安排未来付款并设置提醒、为帮工和客户生成收据、调出给会计师的年度报告，并通过银行卡或支付链接向客户收款——全部在对话中完成。

payload.name: ALPS Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: This plugin helps attorneys estimate a non‑binding range of lawyers' professional liability (LPL) insurance premiums based on basic inputs like state, practice area, and attorney count. It provides quick guidance to support early planning and coverage conversations, without collecting personal information or requiring an application.
payload.longDescription: 本插件帮助律师根据州、执业领域和律师人数等基本输入，估算不具约束力的律师职业责任（LPL）保险保费范围。它提供快速指引，支持前期规划和保障讨论，不收集个人信息，也不要求提交申请。

payload.name: Investra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Investra connects your real estate investment workflow to your AI assistant. Search and evaluate property listings, run investment analyses, review projected returns and cash flow, and share investor-ready reports — all from chat. The integration uses the same data, permissions, and plan limits as the Investra web app, so anything done through the assistant matches what you'd see in your account. Built for real estate professionals who want to spend less time on manual analysis and more time advising on deals and closing them.
payload.longDescription: Investra 将房地产投资工作流程连接到 AI 助手。直接在对话中搜索和评估房源、运行投资分析、查看预期回报与现金流，并分享可供投资者使用的报告。该集成使用与 Investra 网页应用相同的数据、权限和套餐限制，因此通过助手进行的任何操作都与你在账户中看到的结果一致。专为房地产专业人士打造，让他们减少手动分析的时间，将更多时间用于交易咨询和促成成交。

payload.name: KeyBid Puls
payload.description: 评估购房用于短租的可行性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Unlock the profitability of short-term rental investments with our ROI Calculator app, tailored for platforms like Airbnb, Booking.com, and VRBO. Users can paste property URLs from sites such as idealista.com, imobiliare.ro, storia.ro, and spitogatos.gr (with more integrations on the way), or upload screenshots from other real estate platforms. The app analyzes the data to deliver instant revenue projections, detailed reports, and a concise conclusion on whether the property is worth purchasing for short-term rentals. Covering 56 countries and over 191 cities, it supports multiple languages including English, Romanian, Spanish, and Greek for seamless global use. Ideal for property owners and investors seeking data-driven insights to evaluate vacation rental opportunities. Explore more at https://keybid.eu/keybid-puls.
payload.longDescription: 使用我们的投资回报率计算器应用，发掘短租投资的盈利能力，专为 Airbnb、Booking.com 和 VRBO 等平台量身打造。用户可粘贴 idealista.com、imobiliare.ro、storia.ro 和 spitogatos.gr 等网站的房产 URL（更多集成正在推出），或上传其他房地产平台的截图。应用分析数据，立即给出收入预测、详细报告，以及该房产是否值得购入用于短租的简明结论。覆盖 56 个国家和超过 191 个城市，支持英语、罗马尼亚语、西班牙语和希腊语等多种语言，方便全球使用。适合希望通过数据洞察评估度假租赁机会的房主和投资者。更多信息：https://keybid.eu/keybid-puls.

payload.name: In Practise
payload.description: 面向投资者的一手研究
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
In Practise runs primary research for fundamental investors. We interview the former operators and executives who ran the companies you're analysing, then turn those conversations into structured, cited research.

This connector brings that library into ChatGPT. You can:

- Search thousands of expert interviews across public and private companies, sectors and business models
- Read full interviews and analysis, with verbatim quotes you can attribute to each source
- Look up companies and the moats behind them, assessed with the 7 Powers framework: scale economies, network effects, counter-positioning, switching costs, branding, cornered resource and process power
- Track the companies you care about with a personal watchlist

Ask ChatGPT about a company, a competitor or an end market, and it pulls the relevant primary-source view from people who were actually in the room, rather than a summary scraped from the web.

Access requires an In Practise library subscription. Learn more at inpractise.com.
payload.longDescription:
In Practise 为基本面投资者开展一手研究。我们访谈曾经运营和管理你所分析公司的前运营人员及高管，再将这些对话转化为结构化、带引用的研究。

此连接器将该资料库带入 ChatGPT。你可以：

- 搜索覆盖上市及非上市公司、行业和商业模式的数千篇专家访谈
- 阅读完整访谈和分析，使用可归属到各个来源的逐字引述
- 查询公司及其护城河，按照 7 Powers 框架评估：规模经济、网络效应、反向定位、转换成本、品牌、独占资源和流程优势
- 使用个人观察名单跟踪关注的公司

向 ChatGPT 询问某家公司、竞争对手或终端市场，它会提取真正亲身参与者的相关一手观点，而非从网上抓取的摘要。

访问需要订阅 In Practise 资料库。了解更多：inpractise.com。

payload.name: Juspay Genius
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask payment questions in plain English: query order and transaction analytics, look up specific orders, check recent outages, and inspect gateway settings — all from your Juspay Dashboard, inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 用日常英语询问付款问题：查询订单和交易分析、查找特定订单、查看近期服务中断，以及检查支付网关设置——全部通过 Juspay Dashboard，在 ChatGPT 中完成。

payload.name: Dr. Klein
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator calculates mortgage interest rates, monthly mortgage payments, the remaining loan balance, and the total interest costs of a mortgage. The property purchase price, down payment, repayment rate, and other financing details can be adjusted individually. Based on the entered data, the calculator provides various financing offers that can be compared side by side at a glance.
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator is suitable for planning a mortgage for the purchase of a property, a new-build project, or a refinancing.
The calculations are based on the latest terms and conditions of more than 600 lending partners. As the final financing terms depend on individual circumstances, the calculated results are provided for guidance only. After completing the calculation, a personalized financing offer can be requested directly from Dr. Klein.
payload.longDescription:
Dr. Klein 按揭计算器计算按揭利率、每月还款额、剩余贷款余额和按揭总利息成本。房产购买价格、首付款、还款比例及其他融资详情均可单独调整。根据输入数据，计算器提供多种融资报价，可并排比较，一目了然。
Dr. Klein 按揭计算器适用于规划购房、新建项目或再融资的按揭贷款。
计算依据来自 600 多家贷款合作伙伴的最新条款和条件。由于最终融资条件取决于个人情况，计算结果仅供参考。完成计算后，可直接向 Dr. Klein 申请个性化融资报价。

payload.name: Solo 401k Calculator
payload.description: 计算 Solo 401k 缴款限额
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find out your maximum Solo 401(k) contribution in seconds. Enter your income, age, and business type to see employee and employer contribution limits, plus after-tax room for Mega Backdoor Roth. Supports sole proprietorships, LLCs, and S-corps. Updated for 2025 and 2026 limits.

* For educational purposes only. Not financial or tax advice. Consult a professional before making financial decisions.
payload.longDescription:
几秒内了解你的 Solo 401(k) 最高缴款额。输入收入、年龄和企业类型，即可查看员工及雇主缴款限额，以及 Mega Backdoor Roth 可用的税后缴款空间。支持个体经营、LLC 和 S-corp。已更新为 2025 和 2026 年限额。

* 仅供教育用途。不构成财务或税务建议。作出财务决定前，请咨询专业人士。

payload.name: Per Diem
payload.description: 用 AI 分析你的财务状况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Per Diem lets you analyze your full financial life with AI. Connect your Per Diem account to ask questions about your net worth, account balances, holdings, transactions, budgets, current-year cash flow, and FIRE plan.

Use it to answer questions like:

“Can we afford a trip to Mexico next winter?”
“When am I projected to reach financial independence?”
"How much can I spend per day to stay on budget this month?"
“Summarize my net worth and biggest holdings.”
“Find recent transactions from Amazon or restaurants.”
“How concentrated is my portfolio?”

Per Diem provides read-only financial context from your connected accounts and planning data so ChatGPT can help you understand spending patterns, review budgets, inspect transactions, evaluate portfolio concentration, and reason about your path to financial independence. Per Diem does not move money, make trades, change your data, or provide legal, tax, accounting, or investment advice.
payload.longDescription:
Per Diem 让你用 AI 分析完整的个人财务生活。连接 Per Diem 账户后，可询问净资产、账户余额、持仓、交易、预算、当年现金流及 FIRE（财务独立、提前退休）计划。

用它回答这样的问题：

“我们负担得起明年冬天去墨西哥旅行吗？”
“预计我什么时候能实现财务独立？”
“为了不超出本月预算，我每天可以花多少钱？”
“总结我的净资产和最大的持仓。”
“查找近期 Amazon 或餐厅的交易。”
“我的投资组合集中度如何？”

Per Diem 从已连接账户和规划数据中提供只读财务背景，让 ChatGPT 帮助你了解支出模式、审查预算、检查交易、评估投资组合集中度，并分析你实现财务独立的路径。Per Diem 不会转移资金、进行交易、更改数据，也不提供法律、税务、会计或投资建议。

payload.name: PointBagel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PointBagel keeps track of your U.S. credit cards and points, and does the math on them. Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own wallet: which card earns the most on a purchase, what your points are worth, whether an annual fee is still earning its keep, and which transfer bonuses are live right now. The answers come from your actual cards and spending, priced with PointBagel's verified data on programs, transfer partners, and point values, not from a model's memory.

The connection is read-only. ChatGPT can see your cards, balances, and spending, but nothing can move points or money. Point values are estimates, and the answers say so.

You'll need a PointBagel account with your cards added. Setup takes a few minutes at pointbagel.com.
payload.longDescription:
PointBagel 追踪你的美国信用卡和积分，并完成相关计算。连接后，ChatGPT 可回答有关你实际钱包的问题：购买时哪张卡的回报最高、积分值多少钱、年费是否仍然划算、当前有哪些转点奖励。答案依据你的实际卡片和消费，并采用 PointBagel 核实的积分计划、转点伙伴与积分价值数据进行估值，而非模型记忆。

此连接为只读。ChatGPT 能查看卡片、余额和消费，但任何工具都无法转移积分或资金。积分价值为估算，答案会明确说明。

需要一个已添加卡片的 PointBagel 账户。在 pointbagel.com 上花几分钟即可完成设置。

payload.name: facturillo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: facturillo keeps your Panamanian receipts ("facturas") organized automatically — scan the DGI QR code and every line item, vendor, and total is captured. This app connects ChatGPT to your facturillo account with read-only access, so you can ask natural questions about your real spending: "How much did I spend on groceries last month?", "Where did I buy this?", "Which store do I visit most?". Answers come from your actual receipt data — totals, line items, vendors, payment methods — never estimates. Requires a facturillo account (facturillo.com); data features require an active plan.
payload.longDescription: facturillo 自动整理你的巴拿马收据（“facturas”）——扫描 DGI 二维码，即可录入每项明细、商家和总额。此应用以只读权限将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 facturillo 账户，让你用自然语言询问真实支出：“我上个月买食品花了多少钱？”“这个东西是在哪里买的？”“我最常去哪家店？”回答来自真实收据数据——总额、项目明细、商家和支付方式——绝不是估算。需要 facturillo 账户（facturillo.com）；数据功能需要有效的付费方案。

payload.name: Nogogo AI

payload.name: Whisper Money
payload.description: 通过对话了解个人财务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:

You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.
payload.longDescription:
Whisper Money 是一款隐私优先的个人理财应用：你的财务数据属于你，绝不会与第三方共享。此应用将 ChatGPT 连接到你自己的 Whisper Money 账户，让你通过日常语言分析资金情况，无需逐一点击仪表盘。

同步的银行数据受到保护：从银行连接导入的交易可以分类和添加标签，但不能编辑或删除；余额只能记录到手动账户。你仍然可以向已连接银行的账户添加自己的手动交易——同步永远不会删除它们。数据范围限于你登录的账户，包括你所属的共享空间。应用仅能读写记账记录——绝不能转移资金、付款或访问 Whisper Money 之外的任何账户。

需要订阅付费（Pro）方案的 Whisper Money 账户。登录通过 Whisper Money 自身的OAuth流程进行——ChatGPT 无法看到你的密码，你可随时在账户设置中撤销访问权限。

payload.name: OptionsAhoy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32.
